name: com.justconnectus/public
title: JustConnectUs: companies hiring in Israel
description: Find jobs in Israel: 6,500+ openings at 700+ companies, with careers pages and apply links. Daily.

tools.name: list_companies_hiring_in_israel
tools.description:
Companies hiring in Israel, each with a link to its own careers page and how many jobs it has open in Israel (or remote from Israel). Refreshed daily from the companies' careers sites.
Use when: the person asks which companies are hiring in Israel, wants a list of careers pages, or looks for a company by name. Not for: one company's openings.
Input: `query` is part of a name ("check point"); `hiring_only` defaults to true (false includes companies with no openings right now); `sort` most_openings or name; `page` from `next_page`.
Returns: `companies[]` with `name`, `slug`, `website`, `careers_page_url` (the company's own site), `open_jobs`, `jobs_url` (its openings on JustConnectUs) and `on_justconnectus` (true: it takes applications and referrals on JustConnectUs); `total`, `next_page`, and `counts` for the whole directory.

query.description: Part of a company name, e.g. "check point" or "teva"

hiring_only.description: Only companies with open jobs now (default true)

page.description: Page number, from `next_page` of the previous call (50 a page)

tools.name: get_company_careers
tools.description:
One company: its careers page, website, open job count, and the roles and cities it is hiring for most.
Use when: the person names a company and wants its careers page or what it is hiring for. Not for: the list of jobs.
Input: `company` is a `slug` from list_companies_hiring_in_israel or a name, e.g. "Wiz". When several companies match a name, or none does but some are spelled alike, the error lists them in `candidates`.
Returns: the company as in list_companies_hiring_in_israel, plus `top_roles[]` and `top_cities[]` (`name`, `slug`, `open_jobs`).

company.description: The company: its `slug` from list_companies_hiring_in_israel (e.g. "wiz"), or its name (e.g. "Check Point")

tools.name: list_company_jobs
tools.description:
The open jobs at one company in Israel (or remote from Israel), newest first, 50 a page, each with a link to the posting on the company's own site.
Use when: the person wants a company's openings. Not for: comparing companies.
Input: `company` as in get_company_careers; optional `role` (a slug from `top_roles`, or words from a role name: "devops" matches DevOps Engineer, "engineer" every engineering role) and `city` ("Tel Aviv"); `page` from `next_page`.
Returns: `company`, `matched_roles` (with `role`: the company's roles it matched; when none, `available_roles` lists the roles it is hiring for), and `jobs[]` with `title`, `url` (the job on JustConnectUs), `apply_url` (the posting on the company's site, where people apply), `locations`, `work_arrangement`, `employment_type`, `roles`, `language`, `posted_at` and `summary` (the start of the ad; the full text is at `apply_url`); `total`, `next_page`.

company.description: The company: its `slug` from list_companies_hiring_in_israel (e.g. "wiz"), or its name (e.g. "Check Point")

role.description: A role slug from get_company_careers `top_roles` ("software-engineer"), or words from a role name ("devops")

city.description: A city in Israel in English or its slug, e.g. "Tel Aviv" or "tel-aviv"

page.description: Page number, from `next_page` of the previous call (50 a page)
